status: Native shader operation-order defect independently reproduced; corrected helper admission remains separate.
source_findings: GLES and RD skeleton preprocessing sum local bone matrices using exact decoded weights and output xyz. They do not renormalize weights. Scene then applies actual mesh model once with homogeneous1.

Skeleton3D uploads globalBonePose*Skin.bindPose, with no mesh/world factor. Actual mesh model is MeshInstance global transform; canonical jacket/Skeleton globals coincide and mesh resolves that Skeleton.
Inherited production helper and test reference multiply world inside every weighted influence. For nonunit decoded weights this scales translation and is not the native shader equation.
Godot MeshInstance bake_mesh_from_current_skeleton_pose is also unsuitable as sole GPU oracle for nonunit weights: it retains residual(1-sum)*rest in addition to weighted posed vertices.
GPU epoch02 uses1mm nonidentity bone translation plus detached-Skin negative; identity epoch01 is retained only as its narrower model-translation diagnostic.
limits: Synthetic3-vertex native ArrayMesh/Skin, actual jacket decoded weight values, authored64x64 camera and world-coordinate encoding shader; not ordinary gameplay or realistic artwork.
The GPU probe proves operation-order/no-skipped-Skin discrimination, not universal skinning correctness or equality at unlimited coordinates.
GLES actually executed; RD source read only. No Apple Silicon/native target performance or rendering admission.

Headless initial direct startup crashed before script due unwritable XDG directories and is retained rejected. Successful retry uses existing project tools/run.sh. Headless has after-run-only source scope; GPU before/after inventory includes791 actual source/asset/observer/wrapper inputs.
No per-frame Main movement, contacts, source-level fixes, current full integration, garment coverage or AAA acceptance follows.
